lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Mountain Village Town Council on October 15, where a second-reading ordinance would change how MVHA fees are set going forward — shifting from hardcoded figures to an annual fee schedule — alongside a resolution adopting the actual 2027 fee schedules for Village Court and beyond. Norwood has its own unusual moment Thursday evening, with a public hearing on whether to formally remove a sitting Planning Commission member. The Horror Show opens Friday at the Sheridan Opera House and runs through Sunday, with a liquor public hearing Tuesday covering the Palm Theatre permits for the weekend.

notable.stake: Public hearing on alcohol permits for Horror Show crowds up to 1,400.
Council votes on ordinance and resolution setting 2027 MVHA housing fee schedules.
